{"code": "import math
import statistics

# Get all rows from Table S7
rows = get_rows('supp.xls', 'Table S7')

# Filter FOLFOX patients (n=13 as required)
folfox_patients = [r for r in rows[1:] if r[1] == 'FOLFOX']
assert len(folfox_patients) == 13, f"Expected 13 FOLFOX patients, got {len(folfox_patients)}"

# Extract scores (IC50, higher = resistant = higher risk of PD) and truths (PD=1, SD/PR=0)
scores = [float(p[3]) for p in folfox_patients]
truths = [1 if p[2] == 'PD' else 0 for p in folfox_patients]

n_pos = sum(t == 1 for t in truths)
n_neg = sum(t == 0 for t in truths)

u = 0
for s_pos, t_pos in zip(scores, truths):
    if t_pos == 1:
        for s_neg, t_neg in zip(scores, truths):
            if t_neg == 0:
                if s_pos > s_neg:
                    u += 1
                elif s_pos == s_neg:
                    u += 0.5

auc_calculated = u / (n_pos * n_neg)
print(f"Calculated AUC: {auc_calculated:.2f}")
assert abs(auc_calculated - 0.85) < 1e-9, f"AUC mismatch: {auc_calculated} != 0.85"

# Build records
records = []
folfox_row_numbers = [3,4,5,6,9,11,12,13,14,18,19,22,24]  # 1-based row numbers in Table S7 for FOLFOX patients
for idx, p in enumerate(folfox_patients):
    row_num = folfox_row_numbers[idx]
    ic50_ref = cell_ref('supp.xls', 'Table S7', row_num, 4)
    resp_ref = cell_ref('supp.xls', 'Table S7', row_num, 3)
    records.append({
        "id": p[0],
        "score": {"ref": ic50_ref},
        "truth": {"ref": resp_ref, "map": {"SD/PR": 0, "PD": 1}}
    })

CONTRACT = {
    "status": "computed",
    "fields": {
        "unit": {"value": "patient", "evidence": ["article:p31"], "explanation": "Each record is a unique CRLM patient receiving FOLFOX chemotherapy"},
        "platform": {"value": "organoid", "evidence": ["article:p1"], "explanation": "Predictive score is IC50 of FOLFOX measured in patient-derived organoids (PDOs)"},
        "readout": {"value": "ic50", "evidence": ["article:p31"], "explanation": "IC50 (half-maximal inhibitory concentration) of FOLFOX in PDOs is the predictive readout"},
        "direction": {"value": "higher_sensitive", "evidence": ["article:p31"], "explanation": "Higher organoid IC50 (greater drug resistance) correlates with progressive disease (PD, poor clinical treatment response)"},
        "threshold_rule": {"value": "no_binary_rule", "evidence": ["article:p31"], "explanation": "AUC is computed across all possible classification thresholds, no single fixed threshold is used"},
        "threshold_timing": {"value": "not_applicable", "evidence": [], "explanation": "Thresholds are not applicable for area under the ROC curve calculation"},
        "patient_mapping": {"value": "individual_available", "evidence": ["supp.xls/Table S7/R1C1"], "explanation": "Each patient has a unique identifier with matched organoid IC50 and clinical treatment response data"},
        "regimen_match": {"value": "matched", "evidence": ["supp.xls/Table S7/R1C2"], "explanation": "PDOs are tested with the same FOLFOX chemotherapy regimen that the corresponding patient received clinically"},
        "n_units": {"value": 13, "evidence": ["article:p31"], "explanation": "13 patients receiving FOLFOX chemotherapy are included in this analysis"},
        "split": {"value": "same_cohort", "evidence": ["article:p31"], "explanation": "All 13 patients are from the same retrospective study cohort; no independent training/validation split was reported"}
    },
    "headline": {
        "metric": "auc",
        "reported": 0.85,
        "reported_evidence": ["article:p31"],
        "threshold": None,
        "op": None,
        "score_direction": "higher",
        "records": records,
        "blocked_reason": ""
    },
    "notes": [
        "Calculated AUC matches reported 0.85 exactly: 34/(5*8) = 0.85",
        "Positive class: PD (progressive disease, poor treatment response), Negative class: SD/PR (stable disease/partial response, good treatment response)",
        "Outlier patient P18 has PD treatment response but low IC50, contributing to the exact reported AUC value"
    ]
}"}
